verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order and hierarchy: the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow drops below the body copy, the body copy is nearly as big as the headline, and the Inkwell & Lantern logo is squeezed into the bottom-left corner at an illegible size, jammed against the edge next to the fine print. B keeps the order of logo, eyebrow, dominant headline, copy and CTA, and the headline clearly leads. Its flaws: the logo is tiny and sits apart from the eyebrow, the book cover is small and stranded on the busy confetti strip, and the legal text is crammed beside the CTA, almost competing with it.
